blocks.summary: Heavenly Creatures killer Pauline Parker dies in Orkney, aged 88. The death of the convicted murderer in Orkney at the age of 88 brings to an end a 70-year story that inspired an acclaimed film. Will the public change its mind about Meghan? This complicated - and developing - story could prove to be a turning point for Meghan. Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning. The Met Office has issued a fresh wind warning from 18:00 on Monday across the west coast of England, Wales and Scotland and eastern parts of Northern Ireland.
